intro: Jobs similar to mechanical engineers are mostly other engineering fields. By O*NET 31.0 data, the closest are Mechatronics Engineers (85% similar), Aerospace Engineers (83%) and Chemical Engineers (82%). 17 of the 20 are in the same engineering group.
shared: These careers share design work, testing and solving problems with physics and math. O*NET rates complex problem solving and judgment at 3.75 out of 5 for mechanical engineers, and operations analysis at 3.5. Aerospace, materials, industrial and automotive engineering use the same core. Most need a bachelor's degree, like mechanical engineering, and several pay more than the $104,110 median.

faq.q: Which jobs like mechanical engineer pay more?
faq.a: 7 of the 20 similar careers pay more. Computer Hardware Engineers earn $161,740 (55% more), Aerospace Engineers $134,960 (30% more) and Nuclear Engineers $133,970 (29% more), according to BLS May 2025 data. All three usually need the same bachelor's level as mechanical engineering.

faq.q: What jobs are similar to mechanical engineering but need less school?
faq.a: 3 of the 20 similar careers usually need less preparation: industrial engineering technologists and technicians, Mechanical Drafters and electrical and electronics drafters. They often hire with an associate degree, but pay less than the $104,110 mechanical engineer median, so they suit people who want a shorter path into the field.
